readerContracts.auto: Missing values default to auto; auto is case-insensitive and produces no override.
readerContracts.behavior: Preserves the original value unless the caller requests lowercase conversion.

readerContracts.accepts: Any value convertible from the INI string to a wide string
readerContracts.auto: Missing values default to auto; auto is case-insensitive and produces no override.
readerContracts.behavior: Preserves the original value unless the caller requests lowercase conversion.

readerContracts.auto: Missing values and auto produce no override.
readerContracts.behavior: Reads through readString with lowercase conversion.

readerContracts.accepts: Base-10 signed Int32 or 0x-prefixed hexadecimal signed Int32; the entire value must be consumed.
readerContracts.auto: Missing values and auto produce no override.
readerContracts.invalid: Malformed input or values outside Int32 produce no override.
readerContracts.behavior: Uses std::stoi; leading whitespace and a sign are accepted by that parser, but trailing unconsumed characters are rejected.

readerContracts.accepts: The same signed Int32 lexical range as readInt, then converts the parsed result to UInt32.
readerContracts.auto: Missing values and auto produce no override.
readerContracts.invalid: Malformed input or values outside Int32 produce no override; for example 0xFFFFFFFF is rejected.
readerContracts.behavior: Negative decimal values wrap during Int32-to-UInt32 conversion; for example -1 becomes UInt32.MaxValue.

readerContracts.accepts: A value accepted in full by C++ float stream extraction (float32).
readerContracts.auto: Missing values and auto produce no override.
readerContracts.invalid: Malformed input, trailing characters, and values outside float32 produce no override.
readerContracts.behavior: Per-setting code may clamp or reject the parsed float; see each setting's minimum, maximum, and contractNote.

readerContracts.accepts: readUInt input whose converted UInt32 value is less than the enum Count sentinel.
readerContracts.auto: Missing values and auto produce no override.
readerContracts.invalid: Parse failures and values at or above Count produce no override.
readerContracts.behavior: Enum option values in each setting describe the exposed canonical choices.

readerContracts.accepts: Known API-specific upscaler codes or a custom provider name.
readerContracts.auto: Missing values and auto select the runtime default.
readerContracts.invalid: Unknown non-auto strings are treated as custom provider names.
readerContracts.behavior: Known codes use the source mapping and API compatibility remaps; suggestions are not an allowlist.

readerContracts.accepts: Per-setting Boolean, index, float, color, or text formats defined by the overlay parser.
readerContracts.auto: Missing values and auto produce no override.
readerContracts.invalid: Invalid typed values produce no override; valid values may be clamped or mapped by the overlay parser.
readerContracts.behavior: Colors parse through readUInt and mask to 24-bit RGB; index fields clamp to their last available index. Per-setting bounds and transformations are recorded on each setting.

Selected FG Input/Source
dlssg    - Can be used with any FG Output. Supports Hudless out of the box. Limited to games that use Streamline and DLSSG
nvngxfg  - Limited to FSR 3 FG (MFG with DLSS Enabler's dll). Requires DLSSG in the game. Supports Hudless out of the box. Uses Streamline swapchain for pacing. 
fsrfg    - Can be used with any FG Output. Supports Hudless out of the box. 
upscaler - Upscaler must be enabled. Can be used with any FG Output, but might be imperfect with some. To prevent UI glitching, Hudfix is required
fsrfg30  - Can be used with any FG Output. Supports Hudless out of the box. 
xefg     - Can be used with any FG Output. Supports Hudless out of the box. With other outputs than xefg, the game's XeLL can go to any low latency output.

xefg           - requires libxess_fg.dll and libxell.dll

settings.description: Built-in replacement names or a custom Nvngx FG provider name.
settings.contractNote: Applies when FGInput is NvngxFG or FGOutput is DLSSG/FlipMeter.
settings.sourceComment:
Selected FG Nvngx Replacement
Nvngx FG is the lower level DLSSG provider. FGInput=NvngxFG or FGOutput=DLSSG need to be used for this setting to do anything
For example to use Nukems in a game that only has upscaling: FGInput=upscaler, FGOutput=dlssg, FGNvngxReplacement=Nukems
To use Arturs in a game that already supports DLSSG: FGInput=nvngxfg, FGOutput=auto, FGNvngxReplacement=Arturs
None      - No replacement
Nukems    - requires dlssg_to_fsr3_amd_is_better.dll, FSR 3 FG
Arturs    - requires dlss-enabler-headless.dll, FSR 3 MFG
FFX       - requires amd_fidelityfx_dx12.dll OR amd_fidelityfx_loader_dx12.dll + amd_fidelityfx_framegeneration_dx12.dll, FSRFG 3 or 4
Combo     - requires the same as FFX AND Arturs, uses FFX for middle frames and Enabler for the rest. Allow for combining FSR 4 FG and Enabler in 4x and 6x modes
Or the name of a custom FG with 'dlssg', an nvngx_dlssg replacement
None, Nukems, Arturs, FFX, Combo - Default (auto) is Nukems
